describes: packages/plugin/stamp: importing canonical PDF libraries, PieceInfo metadata, ids, the asset engine port and its failures.

cases.name: imports-every-page-as-a-vector-asset
cases.covers: importLibrary opens source bytes on the configured local asset engine with wildcard scope, reads current catalog/page PieceInfo and metadata, registers plain PDF pages, rewrites normalized metadata, extracts source PDFs and inline previews, saves canonical bytes and closes before committing current library/asset descriptors. Current selectors return ordered descriptors, independent binary copies and null for absent cached reads; exporting an absent library rejects.

cases.name: reads-ids-and-display-metadata-from-pieceinfo
cases.covers: Catalog Id, fallback Name and Categories survive. A plain PDF uses page Name as identifier and Subject as label; current kind uses a case-insensitive PDF name, and Categories requires string-array. Empty/unknown/wrong-tag values fall back. Page PieceInfo Id no longer owns asset identity; ids derive from library and identifier.

cases.name: a-name-kind-and-stamp-kinds-read-back
cases.covers: Mixed-case Stamp maps to stamp; empty kind falls back to stamp; an empty embedded library name falls back to Stamps.

cases.name: import-options-override-the-pdf
cases.covers: Caller categories and asset kind override PDF metadata, including empty categories; the existing PDF name wins over the caller name fallback. Current assetName(index) supplies a label, with typed undefined responses falling back to the identifier.

cases.name: a-payload-source-and-its-errors
cases.covers: Current BinarySource payload bytes import successfully. PNG, JPEG and unknown bytes reject invalid-input before any engine call. Explicit malformed null source and numeric payload data reject exact operation-failed PluginErrors with source-owned TypeError causes, then a valid payload recovers.

cases.name: a-cloud-kernel-engine-names-the-fix
cases.covers: An unconfigured remote kernel engine refuses before open with an actionable unsupported PluginError naming the local assetEngine option. canImport changes from optimistic true to false; repeated calls retain the same exact refusal.

cases.name: a-configured-engine-keeps-its-invalid-arg
cases.covers: A configured local asset engine InvalidArg is wrapped in the current invalid-input PluginError with the exact EngineError cause; it does not become the remote-engine configuration hint.

cases.name: missing-services-refuse-before-any-write
cases.covers: Required local catalog/page PieceInfo services reject with explicit engine Unsupported answers; these are service refusals, not absent-service coverage. Empty layouts and a listed page absent from the page registry reject their current exact errors. Every opened document closes and no state commits.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: a canonical stamp library PDF must contain at least one page

cases.name: an-engine-failure-mid-import-adds-nothing
cases.covers: Actual catalog/page metadata write, extraction, render, save and page PieceInfo read failures are wrapped as exact PluginErrors, close their document and commit no library, asset or bytes.

cases.name: a-failed-close-fails-the-import
cases.covers: A finally close failure rejects after successful download and prevents every descriptor/binary commit.

cases.name: previews-must-be-inline-bytes
cases.covers: A valid URL-sourced image is unsupported on the local asset port. An explicitly malformed image missing contentType still caches its byte source with absent MIME. previewWidth sets the actual render request width.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: the asset engine returned a URL-sourced render; asset engines must be local

cases.name: a-render-with-no-image-throws
cases.covers: Explicit malformed null PageImageResult and null source reject with exact source/kind TypeError causes wrapped by the current stamp verb, close and commit nothing.

cases.name: a-second-import-allocates-fresh-ids
cases.covers: Preferred library ids survive once; repeated imports allocate fresh session ids. A preferred library id occupying the next fallback forces an additional uid draw. Asset ids derive independently from each library id and identifier.

cases.name: ids-carry-the-clock
cases.covers: Fresh per-case shipping uid state uses the prefix, fake Date.now base36 and a base36 counter; the complete typed write answer matches the actual clock-dependent library id.

cases.name: concurrent-imports-read-the-store-before-either-lands
cases.covers: Deferred downloads let both imports read before committing. Different library ids own distinct derived asset ids; deleting one library leaves the other intact. Concurrent equal preferred library ids still produce duplicate display-order entries, then deleteLibrary drops every matching entry and asset.

cases.name: an-asset-engine-factory-is-called-once
cases.covers: The current configured local factory is lazy, memoized across two imports and owned by the plugin; destroy closes its documents first and destroys its produced engine once.

cases.name: an-async-asset-engine-factory
cases.covers: A current configured factory may resolve a local engine asynchronously; it is awaited and its produced engine is destroyed on teardown.

cases.name: a-throwing-asset-engine-factory-is-retried
cases.covers: A synchronous factory throw is wrapped with its exact Error cause and retried next call. No engine is owned or destroyed.

cases.name: a-rejecting-asset-engine-factory-is-memoized
cases.covers: An asynchronously rejecting factory is memoized as that rejection; the next call does not invoke it. Cleanup swallows the owned rejection and destroys no engine.

cases.name: an-engine-instance-is-not-destroyed
cases.covers: A configured local engine instance is borrowed and never destroyed by the plugin. Teardown clears all binary resources.

cases.name: the-plugin-factory-defaults
cases.covers: The actual shipping definition retains workspace scope, defaults, state and inScope. With no assetEngine configured the current remote kernel engine refuses import before open; a separate explicit local-host check proves the same defaults render at 256 pixels successfully.

cases.name: named-registry-order-filters-and-preview-cache
cases.covers: Current PDF title and named-page registry own labels and page order; hidden templates warn once. The cached picker thumbnail is distinct from width-bucket ghost previews; repeated widths reuse one render and failures fall back to the thumbnail.

cases.name: persistence-restores-canonical-bytes-and-unsubscribes
cases.covers: The shipping persistence helpers restore file-owned identity, save canonical bytes after changes, delete removed libraries, and stop observing after unsubscribe; memory storage copies caller bytes.
